svg.title: Your 10-Week Journey — Four Modules
svg.desc: Vertical sequence of four stacked cards: 1 Foundations, Weeks 1 to 2. 2 Core Practices, Weeks 3 to 5. 3 Your Track, Weeks 6 to 8. 4 Mastery, ongoing. Footer reads: Rule of One — pick one track, finish it, then add another.
